sonnetRuns.note: first launch, NOT blind: filenames carried -false and rows.json (with expect) sat in the same directory; recorded, not reported as the result
blind run: neutral names p1..p8 in a directory holding only images, deterministic shuffle, prompt = image path + claim only
blind repeat on 2026-09-29: same p1..p8 images, same claim-only prompts, fresh Sonnet agents

corpusRuns.note: 3 parallel sessions, a recording zip per row

login.outcome: passed; final frame checked by hand

jev.name: Jev, typed judge
jev.sees: the settled page as text: url, title, a page-text excerpt, up to 60 element-map labels, and the claim, in one typed request
jev.timed: one POST round trip, measured in the runner around fetch()
jev.answers: outcome (verified / contradicted / unsupported) with probabilities, errorShown, blocked; a rule table turns them into passed, failed or escalate

sonnet.name: Sonnet, screenshot proxy
sonnet.sees: one 780×493 frame of the same settled page, captured by vibium screenshot, and the claim; nothing else
sonnet.timed: self-timed: date +%s%3N before the Read and after the decision; agent wall from spawn to hand-back is kept beside it
sonnet.answers: passed, failed or inconclusive, with a one-line reason

check.name: vibium check, model alone
check.sees: the live browser and the claim; it drives its own tool loop (map, text, screenshot) until it decides or its budget ends
check.timed: process wall of vibium check, measured in the runner
check.answers: passed or failed with a summary
